title: Cosmic Peacock Muse
description: A surreal silhouette of a woman whose head and hair transform into a swirling mass of vibrant peacock feathers, glowing red moons, and small floating landscape paintings. Below her, a dark fantasy landscape shows a winding river with paw prints leading to a cat-like figure holding a lantern on a rocky shore, a tall ship sailing nearby, and a small sailboat on stormy waters under a blood moon.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a woman's dark silhouette whose flowing hair merges into a cosmic explosion of iridescent peacock feathers, glowing red moons, and tiny embedded landscape paintings. Her form stands against a stormy night sky with lightning. Below is a mystical mountain valley with a winding river reflecting red glowing paw prints, a black cat figure with a lantern standing on rocks, a tall sailing ship on the water, and a small sailboat battling waves under a large blood moon.
